estimand: out-of-sample forecast of next-24h observed notional-weighted liquidation intensity (sum of notional_usd per coin per 24h bucket) on the verified frozen combined liquidation panel, C2 (funding-conditioned) vs B1 (RV-only baseline)
grain: coin-day (coin, 24h bucket); target = next-24h sum(notional_usd); features = last value within the current 24h bucket (causal, pre-target)

validation.note: diagnostic only; no threshold-shopping, no holdout tuning, no model selection on validation

splits.split_kind: chronological expanding walk-forward; no random split

binary_event_rule: event = 1 if next-24h observed intensity > train-period median intensity (median computed on train only, applied ex-ante to test); never tuned on test outcomes

metric_definitions.QLIKE: qlike(y, yhat) = y/yhat - log(y/yhat) - 1 for y>0, yhat>0; intensity forecast via OLS of log(y) on features, yhat = exp(pred); lower is better
metric_definitions.Brier: mean((p - e)^2) over test observations; p = logistic-regression predicted probability of the binary event; lower is better
metric_definitions.LogLoss: -mean(e*log(p) + (1-e)*log(1-p)); p = logistic-regression predicted probability; lower is better

contrast: paired C2 - B1 per test observation; improvement if C2 metric < B1 metric (diff < 0)

inference.method: block bootstrap across the 3 chronological test blocks (resample blocks with replacement)
inference.correction: Holm step-down over the joint 3-metric family (QLIKE, Brier, LogLoss)

materiality_rule: relative reduction (mean_B1 - mean_C2) / mean_B1 >= 0.02 for each metric; mean_abs_outcome denominator where applicable
gates_per_metric: block-bootstrap 95% CI of mean diff entirely below zero (C2 strictly better)
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED only if ALL three metrics in the joint family clear every gate; otherwise honest NOT_SUPPORTED; no threshold-shopping or floor relaxation after seeing outcomes
independent_recompute: separate numpy/stdlib-only code path (fclr_liq_oos001_recompute_20261121T055825Z.py) reproducing the OOS evaluation; verdict must not be a single-implementation artifact
cross_references: FCLR-XSEC-002 (funding->RV HIGH-RV SUPPORTED; OOS forward confirmations all failed)
FCLR-XSEC-008 (alternative regime conditioning NOT_SUPPORTED; XSEC program terminal)
Track B modeled breaches (NOT_MET); Track A combined panel (NOT_MET)
track_separation: this campaign forecasts OBSERVED liquidation intensity only; never conflates with Track B modeled boundary breaches or RV forecasts
